top_signals.title: Law firm at centre of BHP mammoth lawsuit sued by its own funder
top_signals.summary: City law firm Pogust Goodhead is facing an £84m lawsuit from its own funder over a dispute related to its high-profile case: the record-breaking group action against mining giant BHP. The firm, formerly known as PGMBM, recently secured a major victory in one of the largest legal actions ever heard in the English courts. Last [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
